items.definition:
a thin cylinder of finely cut tobacco rolled in paper for smoking
He lit a cigarette after dinner.

a beloved person
Come here, my darling.

a prediction of future events
The weather forecast predicts rain tomorrow.

a person or thing that receives something
The receiver of the package signed for it.

a person who performs duties for others
The old house had many servants.

the way in which something is organized or arranged
The setup of the new office is very efficient.

a bony framework enclosing the brain
The human skull protects the brain.

a long, narrow opening
Insert the coin into the slot.

A space entirely devoid of matter.
The vacuum cleaner picked up all the dust.

A change or difference.
There is a lot of variation in the weather this week.

A person who designs buildings.
The architect presented the plans for the new library.

A wide, shallow container for holding liquids.
She washed her hands in the basin.

A small protuberance on a plant that develops into a flower, leaf, or shoot.
The rose bush is full of new buds.

The chief male servant of a house.
The butler announced dinner was served.

A person or company that undertakes a contract to provide materials or labor to perform a service or do a job.
We hired a contractor to renovate our kitchen.

A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere.
The diameter of the circle is 10 centimeters.

A pair of people or things, especially in music or entertainment.
The musical duo performed a beautiful song.

Cloth produced by weaving or knitting fibers.
This dress is made from a soft cotton fabric.

the way things are arranged
I like the layout of the new office.

a substance that causes illness or death when eaten or absorbed
Be careful, that plant contains poison.

a person who trains people or animals; a type of soft shoe suitable for sports
The dog trainer taught the puppy new tricks.

a large building for storing goods
The company stores its products in a large warehouse.

a short biography or biographical sketch
Read my bio on the company website to learn more about me.

a hot glowing body of ignited gas that is generated by something on fire
The candle's flame flickered in the breeze.

the successful completion of a course of study
Her graduation ceremony is next month.

a slight indication or suggestion
She gave me a hint about the answer to the puzzle.

the line at which the earth's surface and the sky appear to meet
The sun dipped below the horizon.

a public house providing food, drink, and lodging for travelers
We stayed at a charming old inn during our trip.

quantity
We need a large quantity of materials for the project.

accommodation
We found cheap accommodation near the beach.

a divine favor or gift
Her recovery was a true blessing.

a burial ground
They visited the cemetery to pay their respects.

an act of showing or proving something
The scientist gave a demonstration of the new experiment.

a thread or filament from which a textile is made
Eating enough fiber is important for digestion.

a secret word or phrase that must be used to gain admission to something
You need to enter your password to log in.

a rhythmic throbbing of the arteries
The doctor checked her pulse.

an amount of money that you pay regularly to receive a product or service
My magazine subscription expires next month.

a yellow alloy of copper and zinc
The statue was made of brass.

a low, continuous humming or murmuring sound
I heard a buzz from the beehive.

a type of heavy oil used as fuel
This car runs on diesel.

a brief downward movement or slope
There was a slight dip in sales.

a diagram showing the relationship between two or more variables
The report included a graph showing sales figures.

the action of measuring something
Accurate measurement is crucial in scientific experiments.

a strong, regular, repeated pattern of movement or sound
The music had a catchy rhythm.

unwanted email
My inbox is full of spam.

a pile or heap
There's a stack of books on the table.

the rise and fall of the sea
The tide is coming in, so the beach will get smaller.

a metal pin or bar
He secured the door with a heavy bolt.

a small stream
A small brook runs through the forest.

a sound or series of sounds caused by the reflection of sound waves
The cave produced a loud echo when I shouted.

the action of inventing something, typically a process or device
The invention of the internet changed the world.

the intervening period of time
The food will be ready in 20 minutes; in the meantime, you can set the table.

activity done for enjoyment when one is not working
Hiking is a popular form of recreation in this area.

a rough or unfinished drawing or painting
She quickly drew a sketch of the landscape.

Thanksgiving
We celebrate Thanksgiving with a big family dinner.

a place where people work
Safety is a top priority in the workplace.

a unit of energy in food
This snack contains a lot of calories.

an object for holding things
Please put the leftovers in a plastic container.

a person who works with cattle
The cowboy rode his horse across the prairie.

Global Positioning System
We used the GPS to find our way through the city.

the process of gathering crops
The farmers celebrated a good harvest this year.

a heading at the top of an article or page
The headline on the newspaper caught my attention.

old or discarded articles that are considered useless or of little value
My garage is full of old junk.

entrance hall
We waited for them in the hotel lobby.
